name: The Changing Jamuna River
story: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR captured this braided river system before and during peak monsoon. Your task: identify the inundation extent using radar backscatter signatures.

name: Brahmaputra Flood Surge
story: Torrential monsoon rains upstream overwhelmed the Brahmaputra River in Assam. Cloud cover is 100% overcast. Use NISAR L-band SAR to penetrate clouds and map surge zones.

name: Amazon Wetland Dynamics
story: Seasonal flood pulses submerge thousands of square kilometers of dense rainforest. NISAR S-band radar penetrates canopy to map sub-canopy inundation.
